qualification.details: Procurement - Senior Consultant: Master's in Supply Chain/ Public Procurement/ Project Management/ MBA OR equivalent. Experience: Minimum Two year of post-qualification experience in legal advisory roles, preferably in healthcare, government, or public sector institutions. Experience: Minimum Seven years of experience in IT support roles within healthcare or institutional settings. Architect Consultant: Master's degree in architecture. Experience: Minimum Two year of professional experience in architectural design, spatial layouts, or institutional infrastructure projects. Hospital Quality Management-Consultant: Master's In Hospital Administration/ Public Health. Experience: Minimum Two years in experience in hospital quality/ management.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BECIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BECIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Broadcast Engineering Consultants India (BECIL) for deployment in Central Government Hospital Delhi/NCR.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under BECIL Advt No 559?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for various consultant positions including Procurement, Legal, IT Technical, Architect, and Hospital Quality Management.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 11-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official registration portal provided by BECIL to complete their submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the announced consultant posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 per month depending upon the specific post and its requirements.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PWD categories are exempted from paying the application fee and it is NIL for them.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Procurement Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Supply Chain, Public Procurement, Project Management, MBA, or an equivalent relevant qualification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for BECIL Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions offered are purely on a contract basis for deployment in Central Government Hospitals located in Delhi/NCR.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection stages involved in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes initial scrutiny and shortlisting of applications based on eligibility followed by forwarding candidate lists to the client for interviews or assessments.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can visit the official BECIL website at www.becil.com or use the direct application link provided in the important links section of this article.
